rule: Each cell is found by its Row ID and must still hold "old" before it is written; the item number must match. Wrong year -> Year Produced = Lionel's years for that catalog number (findmylionel item page: Year Released / catalog list; quoted per cell), written as text. Description on the wrong number (a description-mismatch, or a run of rows shifted off their numbers) -> the BOX NUMBER wins: the Description becomes Lionel's own short title for the row's own number (findmylionel's list for that number, or the tab's lionel.com-feed row of the same number), corroborated where possible by the row's lionel.com link and trainz; the Item Number is never changed. With it, Year Produced takes that item's years when the row's year belonged to the old item, and Road Name takes the railroad Lionel's title names, only when the row names a different one. Gauge -> the gauge a source names for that catalog number (Write 1b's 26 Standard cells + the check's 16; the same row in both lists is one cell). Duplicates of feed rows, identical pairs and wrong Reference Links are NOT changed here (deletes and link changes are separate decisions); medium findings were looked at again and only those re-graded high are in. Item Number, Row ID and every other cell unchanged; no rows added or deleted.
